conclusion_quantitative: unknown (Act) specifies 4 of 5 categories: 10+ autonomy limits, 10+ clarification rules, 10+ validation rules, 6 escalation rules; none for approval gates. Strongest: autonomy limits.
conclusion_qualitative: This skill (no name given; the file is named by its hash) turns a design document into resolved decisions, updated architecture docs and implementation task files across five phases, with the main agent deciding and cheaper subagents doing the reading and writing. Its strongest rule is a hard gate: no docs or tasks are produced while any question is open, questions are closed only by investigation, and named design alternatives always go to the user. Otherwise the agent runs each phase to completion without asking, never delegates decisions, writes tasks only to allowed folders and keeps the design document. It verifies each phase with checklists, and stops to explain any deviation from its instructions.

Within each phase the agent does not ask whether to continue or wait for approval of partial output, and it moves on automatically when every decision is backed by evidence, flagging medium-confidence ones for review. It must never hand a decision to a subagent, must write task files only inside the allowed framework project `.tasks` folders and never inside the customer project that holds the design document, and must not delete the design document.
